name: George Julius Allen
notable_stories: Graduated from Ottawa University; for health reasons, he moved his family to Colorado in a covered wagon, working as a stagecoach driver from Beulah to Pueblo

Because of ill health he moved his family to Colorado by covered wagon a few years after marrying; he once drove a stage coach between Beulah and Pueblo, and the family later returned to Marceline by covered wagon.
milestones: Co-founded the First Baptist Church in Marceline (1888)
Established and operated a bank with his father in Marceline
Prominent real estate and implement businessman
Religion: With his father organized the First Baptist church in Marceline in April 1888; two of its seven charter members
Buried at Mt. Olivet Cemetery, Marceline
career: Built the large business building (later housing the Allen hotel, Murray's store and the Home Improvement Company) in 1906
Owned and operated a bank with his father; also in the real estate and implement business
locations: Mt. Olivet Cemetery, Marceline, Linn County, MO
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Newspaper clippings and obituaries in Bill Allen’s family document (2011)
notes: Parents listed: George Philemon Allen and Juliaetta A. Spring.
